sloka: जिघांसन्तीं ततस्तां तु ज्वलदग्निशिरोरुहाम् ।सव्यमुष्टिप्रहारेण पराजित्य सुभैरवाम् ।। ५.५८.४८ ।।।।
transliteration: jighāṁsantīṁ tatastāṁ tu jvaladagniśiroruhām ।savyamuṣṭiprahāreṇa parājitya subhairavām ।। 5.58.48 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then the frightening form, with its hair burning like sacrificial fire, emerged to kill me. I defeated her hittting with my left fist and entered the city at sunset time.
